sourceFile: 13.BRS-201506 Report Test clean material CD improve NG tension CD+Coil date 30.9.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not reliable because it merges distinct test factors and includes malformed or unrelated outcomes.
issues: Clean material and UV LED change factors are incorrectly merged.
Baseline/test conditions include totals and malformed labels.
Several outcomes are extraction artifacts, not valid comparisons.
Sheet2 and some cited rows appear unrelated or lack context.
Judgements are based on incomplete or mismatched row grouping.
correctionPlan: Split clean-material tests from UV LED condition tests.
Use No Clean as baseline only for clean-material comparisons.
Keep date, sheet, section, type, and test round as grouping keys.
Rebuild outcomes from VP+CD vision, tension, CD+Coil tension, and function tables only.
Remove Sheet2, totals-as-conditions, #DIV/0, and non-comparison stats.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are not sufficient because many do not support the claimed grouping.
